issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException instead of expressing read-only in the type system.
issues.detail: The legacy formats remain registered KnnVectorsFormat services with public constructors, but fieldsWriter throws at write time. This is an LSP violation and a runtime substitute for a static guarantee. Introduce a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype, or fail at construction, so callers cannot hold a format reference that explodes only at first flush.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated rather than imported from its canonical source.
issues.detail: The constant was previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat; the move declares a fresh copy on Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat. Two independent sources of the same on-disk parameter can silently drift. Either re-import the canonical value or move it to a shared backward_codecs spec class with a stated invariant.

issues.description: Constructor still accepts numMergeWorkers and mergeExec that the read-only format silently discards.
issues.detail: The fields were removed but the constructor still takes numMergeWorkers and mergeExec, validates them, then throws them away. The signature lies about behavior on a format that has disclaimed writing. Drop the dead parameters or document explicitly that they are kept only for source compatibility.

issues.description: Protected fields demoted to package-private on a still-public abstract class.
issues.detail: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues remains public abstract with a public nested subclass, but its previously protected fields are now package-private. External subclasses lose access without a compile-time signal explaining why. Either seal/finalize the class or restore protected; the current half-step leaves a public ADT with no usable extension surface.

issues.description: Public API symbols on Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat demoted without a deprecation cycle.
issues.detail: NAME, QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT, and calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval were public on a released format class and are now package-private in the same release as the relocation. That is an undeclared ABI break for external code referencing them by name. Leave them public-and-deprecated for one cycle before removing.

issues.description: Test RW subclasses reach into package-private state and duplicate near-identical wiring.
issues.detail: Lucene99RWScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat and the V0/V1 HNSW RW shims depend on package-private fields of the production class to restore writer behavior, and V1 hardcodes default maxConn/beamWidth instead of using constructor args. Prefer composition via a protected createWriter() hook and parameterize the writer-version choice, rather than two near-duplicate subclasses with silent default fallbacks.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the relocation of Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats into backward_codecs is directionally correct, but the contract work is incomplete and the diff conflates a move, a visibility narrowing, and a behavior change. The dominant issue is that read-only-ness is encoded as a runtime UnsupportedOperationException on fieldsWriter rather than expressed in the type system, while public constructors and SPI registration still hand out usable instances. Supporting concerns: a duplicated DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant, dead numMergeWorkers/mergeExec constructor parameters, and protected fields demoted to package-private on a still-public abstract class. Land after introducing a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat (or failing at construction), de-duplicating the constant, removing or documenting the vestigial parameters, and resolving the visibility inconsistency.
